concept_explanation.what_it_is: A set comprehension is an **expression that creates a new set** by examining multiple values one by one and selecting only those that meet a certain condition.
concept_explanation.how_to_read: `{n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0}` is read as: "It takes `nums` one by one from `n` and adds only those `n`s that satisfy the even condition to the result set."
concept_explanation.key_point: A set retains only one instance of each duplicate value. Therefore, even if the same value appears multiple times in the input, it will appear only once in the resulting set.

answer_explanation.step_by_step: 1) The values that satisfy the condition `if n % 2 == 0` are 2 and 4. 2) Since `set` removes duplicates, only 2 remains. 3) A set comprehension uses a loop and a condition to create a set of results without duplicates. 4) This is a concise way to collect only the values that satisfy the condition.
